title: Vision
description: The model that reads images on the CPU: off, loaded only when an image is to be read (and unloaded when idle), or always loaded; how long it stays idle before it is unloaded; and its preset.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The kind and version this file is written in; always its first field.

title.description: The name clients show for this record; the file's own name when empty.
title.title: Title

mode.description: off: no image is read (annotations go as words, the agent's model is told it takes text only); on-demand: loaded when an image is to be read, unloaded when idle; always: loaded and kept.
mode.title: Mode

idle_minutes.description: Minutes without use after which an on-demand model is unloaded.
idle_minutes.title: Idle

preset.description: The preset the vision slot loads.
preset.title: Preset
